title: Notes from the harbour timetable thread
text:
Notes from the harbour timetable thread.

Somebody on the forum said the 6:40 boat had been retired, somebody else said it had only been renumbered, and the operator page had not been updated since the spring.

We have marked this entry as a low-confidence claim about ferry schedules, because two of the three people in the thread are quoting each other and the third is quoting a photograph of a sign.

Runa Okonkwo, who is quoted in the thread, said only that the boat used to leave at 6:40 and that they had not taken it since 2019.

If anyone has the current printed timetable, please post it. We will correct this page rather than argue about it.
